en: A multi-view color postcard with an orange border featuring landmarks of the city of Pécs. The front shows five photographs: a medieval stone castle or fortress; a domed church or former mosque illuminated at night; a tall television/radio tower on a hill; a modernist multi‑storey building labeled "Hotel Kikelet"; and an abstract modern sculpture on a pedestal in a green hillside setting. The word "PÉCS" is printed in bold black letters in the center. The reverse side is a typical divided postcard back with space for address and message, printed in Hungarian and another language, including a publisher line from Budapest and a printed price in forints.
